requiredControls.name: pinned-publisher-verification
requiredControls.requirement: Verify publisher continuity, artifact digest, signature, expiry, and monotonic sequence before staging or enabling a package.

requiredControls.name: separate-process-isolation
requiredControls.requirement: Run hostile provider code outside the LoomTV process with platform-specific isolation and no renderer privileges.

requiredControls.name: default-deny-egress
requiredControls.requirement: Broker every network request through an origin, DNS, redirect, byte, rate, and timeout policy.

requiredControls.name: opaque-reference-boundary
requiredControls.requirement: Expose only validated opaque references; never pass raw URLs, filesystem paths, credentials, or executable details.

requiredControls.name: profile-and-pairing-revalidation
requiredControls.requirement: Revalidate profile selection, pairing, approval, and revocation for every attachment and playback capability.

requiredControls.name: resource-and-lifecycle-quotas
requiredControls.requirement: Bound CPU, memory, process count, queue depth, response size, duration, cancellation, crash cleanup, and stale capability lifetime.

requiredControls.name: no-install-hooks
requiredControls.requirement: Package staging and update installation must be host-controlled with atomic rollback and no arbitrary scripts or child processes.

threats.scenario: An attacker replaces a plugin package or impersonates its publisher.
Provider code uses a parser, native module, or host interface to escape into the LoomTV process.
Provider code reaches loopback, private services, metadata endpoints, or unapproved Internet destinations.
A plugin reuses a stale profile, pairing, artwork, or playback capability after the user changes authorization.
A provider floods the host with requests, output, processes, or unbounded work.
An update or package hook installs arbitrary code or survives disable/removal.

enablementGates.requirement: Attach evidence for publisher verification and key lifecycle.
Attach platform isolation design and escape testing.
Attach egress broker and profile/pairing authorization evidence.
Attach quota, revocation, rollback, and red-team evidence.
